"use client" import * as React from "react" import { Badge } from "@/components/ui/badge" import { Select, SelectContent, SelectItem, SelectTrigger, SelectValue } from "@/components/ui/select" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow } from "@/components/ui/table" const SKIP = "__skip" /** Import column mapper: each source column picks a target field (or is skipped). */ export default function ColumnMapper({ heading = "Map columns", sourceColumns = [ { id: "email_address", sample: "alex@example.com" }, { id: "full_name", sample: "Alex Morgan" }, { id: "signup", sample: "2026-03-14" }, ], targetFields = [ { id: "email", label: "Email" }, { id: "name", label: "Name" }, { id: "created", label: "Created at" }, ], mapping: initial = { email_address: "email", full_name: "name" }, onChange, }: { heading?: string sourceColumns?: { id: string; sample?: string }[] targetFields?: { id: string; label: string }[] mapping?: Record onChange?: (mapping: Record) => void }) { const [mapping, setMapping] = React.useState(initial) const set = (col: string, field: string) => { const next = { ...mapping } if (field === SKIP) delete next[col] else next[col] = field setMapping(next) onChange?.(next) } return (

{heading}

Column Sample Field Status {sourceColumns.map((c) => ( {c.id} {c.sample} {mapping[c.id] ? Mapped : Skipped} ))}
) }
